newsitem.title: USA: Houston Industries eyes generating assets.
newsitem.headline: Houston Industries eyes generating assets.

text.p: Houston Industries Inc is actively seeking generating assets outside its service territory as the company positions itself to compete in a deregulated electric industry, executives said on Friday.

The Houston-based utility holding company considered bidding on New England Electric System plants put up for sale as that utility restructures but valuations on the assets were too high, Houston Industries President Steve Letbetter said.
"We're also actively pursuing acquisition of generating assets on both coasts," Letbetter said at the company's annual meeting here.

Closing on Houston Industries' merger with NorAm Energy Corp was pushed back to August pending approval from federal regulators, but the delay has not slowed the companies' expansion in the wholesale electric industry, executives said.
NorAm sold 2.7 million megawatt hours in the wholesale market last year, and expected that volume to rise to 4.6 million megawatt hours in the first quarter of this year, executives said.
